scores.notes: Ink-and-watercolor: Jacob asleep on a mat with a stone pillow in the lower foreground, and a swirling white-gold cloud with flame-like strokes in the upper center holding no figure. Painted through all four edges; the only oddity is a candle-like flame burning on top of the standing stone at center (~x780,y300).

Gold-ground icon: Jacob asleep on a mat in the foreground; the upper-center cloud contains only a flame, with stars on the gold sky, a standing stone and a stone altar at right. Gold ground and landscape reach every border; no lettering.

Ink-and-watercolor: Ezekiel on the riverbank with a tablet, four winged living creatures with wheels, and at top center a peaked cloud opening around a blue light orb with no head, face, limbs or robe. Washes reach all edges; the distant exiles at right are requested.

Ink-and-watercolor: Daniel in profile at lower left; white-tunic attendants carry thrones into place; the central throne (~x820,y250) is engulfed in fire and radiance with no occupant, above a river of flame. Indigo cloud washes fill all four edges.

Gold-ground icon: an Israelite column walks between two water walls, with a cloud at top center enclosing only a flame. The far shore shows a walled domed city (~x900,y300) rather than plain desert, a minor deviation; edges are fully painted.

Oil: the central fiery throne (~x760-880,y330-520) holds a seated white-robed body with hands resting on the armrests, its head replaced by glare, so the Ancient of Days is shown as a human figure. Daniel at left and the white-robed assembly are fine; edges are full.

Ink-and-watercolor: families with sheep walk between water walls under a cloud pillar with red-gold fire and no figure. The bottom-right corner (~x1330,y745) has a small inked 'Nk'-like glyph that may be a signature, distinct from the pebble hatching elsewhere.

Gold-ground icon: Moses with a staff, Aaron in ephod and breastplate, Nadab and Abihu with censers, and elders on a blue sapphire pavement, under a cloud at top center enclosing only flame and rays. The breastplate shows gems, not letters; gold ground and rocks reach all edges.

Gold-ground icon: Ezekiel holds a blank tablet at left; four winged creatures with wheels; at top center a sapphire-blue throne-back outline encloses only a flame. Distant exiles on the banks; all borders painted.

Oil: inside the radiance at top center (~x760-860,y60-170), a translucent robed figure with two visible hands sits beneath a flame halo, against the requested 'no visible figure'. Edges are painted throughout, apart from a tiny flat blue patch about 12px square at the extreme top-right corner.

Ink-and-watercolor: Isaiah with a staff at right; the left side of the glowing sanctuary doorway (~x350-460,y260-400) holds a faint line drawing of a raised hand over a sleeve and robe drape, nearly washed out by the light. It is visible on zoom and reads as a ghostly figure; the carved cherubs on the lintel are relief.

Oil: Jacob asleep on a mat with a boulder pillow and a luminous cloud with flame wisps at upper right, with no figure. A cursive painter's signature is clearly visible in the bottom-right corner (~x1270-1350,y735-760).

Gold-ground icon: empty golden thrones on cloud; a flame and rays sit on the central throne (~x500,y120) and pour out as a river of fire; a white-robed assembly at right and Daniel in profile at lower right. Edges are fully painted.

Ink-and-watercolor: Moses with a crook, Aaron in breastplate, Nadab and Abihu with censers, and elders on a blue glass-grid pavement, with a radiant cloud at top center containing only a faint flame. The bright top-center border is the tinted radiance between painted cloud, not bare paper.

Ink-and-watercolor: the sky wash stops short of the left border, leaving a near-white unpainted paper band down most of the left edge and into both top corners. Smoke and a sunburst on the summit show no figure; Moses (right) oddly grips a staff in each hand.

Oil: Moses, Aaron, Nadab and Abihu with censers, and elders on a sapphire-blue paved summit above the camp, with a bright cloud radiance at top center and no figure. Moses holds both a crook and a second straight staff, a minor oddity; edges are full.
Oil: Sinai with a dark smoke vortex and a central starburst at the summit, with no figure, and cracked quaking ground; Moses with a crook among the crowd. Painted to all borders, no lettering.

Oil: at top center of the heavenly court (~x690-790,y40-160) sits an enthroned, bearded, white-haired robed figure with arms spread, flanked by angels, so Yahweh is depicted in human form. Micaiah, the two seated kings and the soldiers are otherwise correct; edges are full.

Oil: Isaiah with a staff before open gilded temple doors, under a shaft of light and cloud with a flame over a bowl at center and no figure. The angel figures are carvings on the door panels; edges are full.

Oil: Israelites walk between dark water walls under a glowing cloud pillar with no figure. The bottom-right corner (~x1290-1370,y735-760) has a looped, handwriting-like signature scribble, unlike the ground brushwork elsewhere.

Icon-style tempera: Isaiah with arms raised in a cedar-panelled sanctuary, under a ring of cloud at top center with rays and a flame and no figure. The winged figures on the walls are carved cherub reliefs; edges are full.

Gold-ground icon: the smoking Sinai has fire at the summit and a diamond of white light in the smoke (~x690,y60), with no figure; Moses with a crook stands between Israelites on cracked, quaking ground, with tents behind. All borders are painted.

Gold-ground icon: the central radiance (~x620-760,y10-130) contains a seated human figure of light with outstretched hands, ringed by angels and also horned red demon-like creatures. Micaiah, the two kings and the soldiers are otherwise correct; edges are full.

Ink-and-watercolor: Micaiah points up at a cloud whose center (~x650,y90) is only flame, with ranks of robed host standing to its left and right. One host member in a red mantle (~x770,y40-130) stands beside, not in, the center; the kings sit under a pavilion with courtiers, and edges are full.
